info.title: Saldo API
info.description: Self-hosted personal finance. Amounts are decimal strings with a currency code.

get.summary: Accounts ordered by type, sort order and name.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of the account name, ignoring case.

get.summary:
Balances of the accounts `GET /accounts` returns for the same filters and
page, in the same order.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of the account name, ignoring case.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: `YYYY-MM-DD`; balances at the end of that day. Default: all time.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: `YYYY-MM-DD`; the balance at the end of that day. Default: all time.

get.summary: The card's plan: budgets, paying account and payment day.

put.summary: Creates (201) or replaces (200) the plan of a credit card account.

delete.summary:
Removes the plan. Settlement transfers the server still keeps in sync
and that are not due yet are deleted; booked ones stay.

get.summary: The card's months, newest first, from the plan's start at the earliest.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First month, `YYYY-MM`; default five months before `to`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last month, `YYYY-MM`; default the current month. At most 36 months.

get.summary: One month with the transactions that count toward it.

put.summary:
Sets the budget from a month on (the current one or later); earlier
months keep theirs.

Counts a purchase or refund of the card in the month after its date.
409 when either month is closed (before the plan, or its payment booked).

delete.summary: Counts the transaction in its own month again.

get.summary: The account's reconciliations, latest statement first.

post.summary:
Marks the splits reconciled; with `book_difference`, books what the
statement has more (or less) as a reconciliation transaction.

get.summary:
The cleared balance (reconciled splits and opening balances) up to the
statement date, and the splits up to it the bank has not confirmed yet.

The attachments of one split, account, tag or bill, oldest first
(unpaginated: an item has only a few).

post.summary: Uploads a file (at most 20 MiB; PDF, images, text, CSV, XML).

get.summary: The file itself, always as a download (never rendered inline).

post.summary:
Checks the password and sets the `saldo_session` cookie. Rate-limited per
IP and per email.
Ends the current session (or revokes the token used) and clears the cookie.

get.summary: The current user, household and role.
How people can log in here (public: the login page asks before login).
Where the provider sends the browser back. Logs the person in.

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: Set by the provider when the person cancelled or was refused.

303.description: Into the app with a session cookie, or back to /login with an error

post.summary:
The desktop app trades its one-time code and verifier for the session
token (a code works once, for two minutes).

get.summary: Starts "Log in with Authentik": redirects the browser to the provider.

parameters.name: redirect
parameters.description: Where in the app to go after login (a path such as `/accounts`).

parameters.name: desktop_port
parameters.description: Desktop app only: the loopback port it waits on (1024 or higher).

parameters.name: desktop_challenge
parameters.description: Desktop app only: base64url SHA-256 of its secret verifier.

303.description: To the identity provider, or back to /login with an error

get.summary:
The caller's login sessions (browsers and desktop apps), newest first.
Personal access tokens are listed by `GET /auth/tokens`.

post.summary:
Signs out everywhere else: ends every login session of the caller except
the one making this request. Personal access tokens stay valid.

delete.summary:
Ends one of the caller's login sessions, which logs that device out.
Ending the current one also clears the cookie, like logout.

get.summary: The caller's personal access tokens (without their secrets).

post.summary: Creates a personal access token for scripts, the importer or the desktop app.

delete.summary: Revokes one of the caller's tokens.

post.summary: Marks a period paid by a split (`bill.paid`).
Opens a paid or skipped period again (`bill.period_reopened`).
Marks an open period as not needing payment.

get.summary: Bills with their next open due date.

post.summary: Creates a bill and its periods up to 60 days ahead.

delete.summary: Deletes a bill and its periods; splits keep no bill.

patch.summary: Changes a bill. Open, never-reminded periods from today on follow a new schedule.

get.summary:
A bill's linked payments (newest first), its due dates over the bill's
whole duration (oldest first) and a summary of what was paid.
A bill's periods, newest first.
Budgets ordered by `sort_order`, then name.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Only active (`true`) or only inactive (`false`) budgets.

post.summary: Creates a budget; an automatic limit also creates the current period's limit.

delete.summary: Deletes the budget and its limits; splits that used it keep no budget.

get.summary: The budget's limits, newest first, with what was spent against each.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only limits ending on or after this date, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Only limits starting on or before this date, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

post.summary: Adds a limit; limits of one budget in one currency may not overlap (409).

delete.summary: Deletes the category; splits that used it keep no category.

get.summary: The current month of every card with a plan.
Every known currency, by code.
Events in sequence order. Remember the last `seq` and pass it as `after_seq`.

parameters.name: after_seq
parameters.description: Only events after this sequence number.

get.summary:
Each message is `id: <seq>` and `data: {"seq", "type", "entity_type",
"entity_id"}`. Reconnecting with `Last-Event-ID` resumes without gaps.

parameters.name: after_seq
parameters.description:
Start after this `seq`. The `Last-Event-ID` header wins; without
either, the stream starts with the next new event.

get.summary: A zip with one CSV file per entity; `transactions.csv` has one row per split.
Everything of the household in one JSON document (format `saldo-export`, version 1).

post.summary: Adds a member with an initial password (owner only).

delete.summary: Removes a member and ends their sessions (owner only).

get.summary: Every goal, by name, with its progress today (unpaginated).

post.summary: Creates a goal starting from today's net worth.
Sends a test message now, also to a paused channel.

get.summary: The event types a channel can receive, for the settings screen.
Piggy banks ordered by sort order and name.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Only active (`true`) or inactive (`false`) piggy banks.

delete.summary: Deletes the piggy bank and its events; the money stays in the accounts.

get.summary: The piggy bank's events, newest first.

post.summary:
Adds or removes money. Refused (422) if the account would hold less than
zero or more than its balance, or the total would pass the target.

delete.summary: Undoes the account's latest reconciliation (409 for an older one).

post.summary: Creates a recurrence. The template splits must pass the ledger rules.

The next dates a schedule fires on, from the household's today, without
saving anything (for the editor's preview).

put.summary: Replaces the whole recurrence (schedule and template).

delete.summary: Deletes the recurrence; transactions it created stay.

post.summary:
Creates the transaction for `date` now. Idempotent: a second call for
the same date returns the existing group with 200 and `created: false`.

get.summary: Per budget: limits starting in each interval and withdrawals booked on it.
Income and expenses per category.
Expenses per expense account and income per revenue account.
Income and expenses per tag; a split counts once for each of its tags.

Income (deposits) and expenses (withdrawals) per interval and currency;
transfers between own accounts are neither.

Average, smallest and largest monthly spending per category, and this
month so far against the average.

parameters.name: months
parameters.description: Complete months before the current one: 3 to 24 (default 12).

get.summary:
The balance projected from today to `to`: transactions already entered
with a later date, recurrences that will fire, and bills at their highest
amount (paid from the account that paid them last; a bill a recurrence
pays counts once). Per account currency, with the lowest point.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last date (inclusive), `YYYY-MM-DD`: after today, at most 24 months ahead.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: One asset or liability account instead of all those counted in net worth.

get.summary:
Asset and liability balances counted in net worth, at the end of each
interval, per account currency.

This month's income (received and planned) minus what was spent and what
is committed: bills, planned withdrawals, what budgets have left, piggy
bank targets and transfers into savings. Primary currency only.

One amount per month for each of the last few years, with the change
against the same months a year earlier.

parameters.name: years
parameters.description: 2 to 5 (default 3), ending with the current year.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: One category, or `none` for splits without one.

get.summary: Rule groups in evaluation order.

delete.summary: Deletes a group with all its rules.

get.summary: Rules in evaluation order (group order, then rule order).

parameters.name: rule_group_id
parameters.description: Only the rules of this group.

post.summary: Runs the rule over every existing transaction and saves the changes.
Dry run: the splits the rule would change (first 100), nothing is saved.

get.summary: The page's views, by `sort_order`, then name (unpaginated).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The list page; only `transactions` for now (the default).

get.summary: Tells the web app whether to show the setup screen (no authentication).

post.summary:
Creates the first user and the household (no authentication; only while
no user exists).

get.summary:
Repeating withdrawals of the last 18 months that no bill covers and nobody
dismissed, by next due date. Computed on each request; unpaginated.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: `household` (default), `mine` or `user:<id>`: filters by the paying account's owner.

post.summary:
Creates a bill first due on the first payment, links the payments (which
pays their periods) and skips the periods left open before the last one.

Stops suggesting payments to the account in the currency. Dismissing
twice changes nothing.

delete.summary: Suggests payments to the account in the currency again.

get.summary:
Groups of tags whose names differ only in case, ordered by name; within a
group the most used tag comes first.

post.summary:
Moves every use of the source tags (splits, recurrences, templates, rules,
attachments) to the target, then deletes the sources; all merges in one
transaction. Returns the target tags in request order.

delete.summary: Deletes the tag and removes it from every split.

get.summary: Templates by `sort_order`, then name.
A template; references deleted since it was saved are left out.
Groups with at least one matching split, newest first.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: A category ID, or `none` for withdrawals and deposits without one.

parameters.name: budget_id
parameters.description: A budget ID, or `none` for withdrawals without one.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text in a split description or the group title.

parameters.name: reconciled
parameters.description: Only groups with a split the bank confirmed (`true`) or not yet (`false`).

parameters.name: amount_min
parameters.description: Smallest split amount, a decimal string such as `"12.50"`.

parameters.name: amount_max
parameters.description: Largest split amount, a decimal string.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description:
The currency of `amount_min`/`amount_max` (default: the household's
primary currency). Only splits in it match an amount range.

parameters.name: has_attachments
parameters.description: Splits with (`true`) or without (`false`) an attachment.

post.summary:
Creates a group with all its splits. Ledger rule failures return 422 with
one detail per broken rule.

put.summary: Replaces the title and every split of a group.

post.summary:
Saves the group as a template, without its dates and reconciled flags.
Opening balances and reconciliations cannot be templates (422).
Queues a delivery again, now, with a fresh attempt budget.

get.summary: Every endpoint of the household, by name. Owner only.

post.summary: Creates an endpoint. The response carries the signing secret, once.

delete.summary: Deletes the endpoint and its delivery log.

get.summary: The endpoint's deliveries, newest event first.

post.summary: Replaces the signing secret; the new one is in the response, once.
Appends a `webhook.test` event that only this endpoint receives.

get.summary: Health check (no authentication).

split_ids.description:
The past payments the bill covers: withdrawals to the account in the
currency, without a bill.

AccountPatch.description: Fields to change. Missing fields stay; `null` clears a nullable field.

type.description: Accepted only if equal to the current type: types never change.

AccountView.description: An account as the API returns it. Amounts are decimal strings.

ActionView.description: An action as stored and as the API shows it.

oneOf.description: The identity provider, if "Log in with ..." is configured.

password.description: Email and password login is allowed.

currency.description: Defaults to the household's primary currency.

type.description:
`reset`: the same amount every period. Carrying what was left is the
budget's `carry`.

BalanceView.description: An account's balance on a date (all time when `date` is `None`).

BillHistoryView.description: A bill's history as the API returns it.

truncated.description: Whether older due dates were left out (more than 2 000).

BillPatch.description: Fields to change; `null` clears `end_date` or `notes`. The currency is fixed.

BillPeriodView.description: One due date of a bill.

BillView.description: A bill as the API returns it. Amounts are decimal strings.

next_due_date.description: The earliest open period's due date, if any.

items.description: Largest expenses first.

id.description: The category or tag; `null` for splits without one.

BreakdownReport.description:
Income and expenses per category or per tag. A split with several tags
counts once for each; `id: null` collects splits without one.

BudgetLimitView.description:
A budget limit with what it received from the limit before it, what was
spent against it (withdrawals booked on the budget, dated inside the
limit, in its currency or with a foreign amount in it) and what is left:
`amount + carried - spent`, negative when overspent.

carried.description:
Carried in from the previous limit (negative with carry `all` after
overspending); computed when read, never stored.

oneOf.description: `null` removes the automatic limit (existing limits stay).

BudgetReport.description:
Per budget: the limits starting in each interval (budgeted) and the
withdrawals booked on it (spent). `budget_id: null` is spending without
a budget.

BudgetView.description: A budget as the API returns it.

oneOf.description: `None` when the budget has no automatic limit.

carry.description:
What a limit passes on to the next one that starts the day after it:
`none`, `leftover` (what was left) or `all` (overspending too).

earlier.description:
Only in the plan's first month: the transactions of the month before
the plan that are not counted here and can be moved in. Oldest first.

splits.description:
Oldest first: the month's own transactions (also those moved out,
which do not count here) and those moved in from the month before.

CardCycleDetailView.description: One month with the transactions that count toward it.

difference_after_settlement.description:
For a frozen or hand-managed month: `spent` minus what the transfer
paid. `None` while the server keeps the transfer in sync.

moved_in.description: Spending moved here from the month before.

moved_out.description: Spending of this month's dates moved to the next month.

spent.description: Purchases minus refunds counted in this month (after moves).

CardMoveRecordView.description: A move as stored, for the export.

amount.description: Positive for a purchase, negative for a refund.

moved_in.description: Dated in the month before and counted here.

moved_out.description: Dated in this month and counted in the next.

CardSummaryView.description: A card's current month, for the accounts list.

net.description: Income minus expenses: what was saved.

savings_rate_bp.description:
`net / income` in basis points (2500 = 25%); negative when spending
was larger, `null` without income.

CashFlowReport.description:
Income (deposits) and expenses (withdrawals) per interval. Transfers,
opening balances and reconciliations are neither.

average.description: Months without spending count as zero.

this_month_vs_average_bp.description: `(this_month - average) / average`; `null` when the average is zero.

items.description: Largest average first.

CategoryAveragesReport.description:
Average monthly spending per category over complete months, against this
month so far.

from.description: The first and last day of those months.

months.description: How many complete months the averages cover.

color.description: A palette colour name (see `POST /categories`); `null` clears it.
One of [`CATEGORY_COLORS`], or `None` for no colour.

config.description:
Fields to change; others (such as a token you never see) are kept,
and `null` removes an optional one.

event_types.description: Replaces the event types the channel receives.

ChannelSettings.description: A channel's settings without secrets, as the API returns them.

has_token.description: Whether an access token is stored (never shown).

push_service.description: webpush: the browser vendor's push service (scheme and host only).

ChannelView.description: A channel as the API returns it: no tokens or push keys.

event_types.description: The event types this channel receives (see `GET /notification-types`).

currency.description: Defaults to the household's primary currency.
Defaults to the household's primary currency.

remind_days_before.description: Days before the due date of the first reminder (default 3).

skip.description: Periods left out between due dates (1 on monthly = every 2 months).

carry.description:
What a limit passes on to the next one starting the day after it:
`none` (default), `leftover` or `all` (overspending too).

color.description: red, orange, amber, lime, green, teal, sky, blue, violet, pink or gray.

config.description:
ntfy: `{ server_url, topic, token? }`; gotify: `{ server_url, token }`;
email: `{ to }`; webpush: the browser's `PushSubscription.toJSON()`.

event_types.description:
Event types to receive (see `GET /notification-types`); default the
bill reminders.

owner_user_id.description: Count one member's accounts only; default the whole household.

target_amount.description: A decimal string; below today's net worth for paying debt off.

currency.description: Defaults to the household's primary currency.

account_ids.description: Asset accounts in the piggy bank's currency; at least one.

currency.description: Defaults to the household's primary currency.

book_difference.description:
Book a difference as a reconciliation transaction; otherwise a

statement_balance.description:
The statement's closing balance in the account's currency (incoming

statement_date.description: `YYYY-MM-DD`; not before the account's last reconciliation.

filters.description: A flat object of strings, numbers and booleans: at most 30 keys and 2 KB.

sort_order.description: Defaults to after the last template.

include_import_events.description: Also send events written by the importer. Default false.

token.description: Shown only now; send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

settlement_day.description:

starts_cycle.description: The first month the plan covers.

EventNotice.description:
The short form of an event that live listeners (`GET /events/stream`)
receive: enough to know what changed, not the whole entity.

EventView.description: One row of the event log, as `GET /events` returns it.

payload.description: The full payload, also the webhook body.

ExportDocument.description:
The whole household in the API's own representations. Attachment files
are not embedded (only their metadata and SHA-256); sessions, the event
log and import bookkeeping are not exported.

credit_card_moves.description: Card transactions counted in the month after their date (Phase 12).

credit_card_plans.description: Credit card plans with their budgets (Phase 12).

net_worth_goals.description: Net worth goals with their progress on the export day (Phase 10).

reconciliations.description: Reconciliations with the splits they confirmed (Phase 9).

ExternalRefView.description: One import mapping (`external_refs`), so re-imports keep working after a restore.

ForecastCurrency.description: The projected balance in one currency.

items.description: Every planned amount, by date.

lowest.description: The lowest end-of-day balance in the span (the earliest on a tie).

points.description: The balance at the end of each interval.

start_balance.description: The balance at the end of today.

account_id.description: `None` for a bill nobody has paid yet (counted in the total only).

amount.description: Positive when money comes in, negative when it goes out.

source_id.description: The transaction group, recurrence or bill.

target_amount.description: A new target makes the goal able to alert again.

average_monthly_change.description: The average monthly change over the last 12 complete months.

current.description: Net worth today (the goal's scope and currency).

projected_date.description: When that average would reach the target; `null` when it does not.

required_monthly.description: What each month until the target date must add; `null` without one.

app.description: Always `saldo`: lets the desktop app check it found a Saldo server.

HistoryAccount.description: An account as a payment shows it.

HistoryDueDate.description: One due date in a bill's history.

HistoryPayment.description: A split linked to the bill, by `bill_id` or by paying one of its periods.

amount.description: A decimal string in `currency`, which may differ from the bill's.

due_date.description: The due date this split paid, if any.

HistoryRange.description: The dates a history covers, both included.

HistorySummary.description:
Payments in the bill's currency, summarised. Amounts are `null` without
any such payment.

other_currency_count.description: Linked payments in another currency, left out of the figures above.

large_transaction_amount.description:
Splits at or above this amount (a decimal string in the primary
currency) notify as `transaction.large`; `null` turns it off.

Splits at or above this amount (primary currency) notify as
`transaction.large`; `None` means off.

currency.description: A new currency needs a new `amount` too.

amount.description: The budget in the card's currency, more than zero.

items.description: An account as the API returns it. Amounts are decimal strings.
An account's balance on a date (all time when `date` is `None`).
A bill as the API returns it. Amounts are decimal strings.

next_due_date.description: The earliest open period's due date, if any.

items.description:
A budget limit with what it received from the limit before it, what was
spent against it (withdrawals booked on the budget, dated inside the
limit, in its currency or with a foreign amount in it) and what is left:
`amount + carried - spent`, negative when overspent.

carried.description:
Carried in from the previous limit (negative with carry `all` after
overspending); computed when read, never stored.

items.description: A budget as the API returns it.

oneOf.description: `None` when the budget has no automatic limit.

carry.description:
What a limit passes on to the next one that starts the day after it:
`none`, `leftover` (what was left) or `all` (overspending too).

color.description: One of [`CATEGORY_COLORS`], or `None` for no colour.

items.description: One delivery attempt record, as `GET /webhooks/{id}/deliveries` lists it.
One row of the event log, as `GET /events` returns it.

payload.description: The full payload, also the webhook body.

items.description: A piggy bank. Amounts are decimal strings in its currency.

accounts.description: The linked accounts with the amount saved in each.

left_to_save.description: Target minus saved, never below zero; `None` without a target.

items.description: A finished reconciliation.

difference.description:
What the statement had more than the confirmed splits ("0.00" when
they agreed); booked as the `difference_group_id` transaction.

split_ids.description: The splits it confirmed, the difference's included.

apply_rules.description: Whether rules run on the transactions it creates.

fired_through.description: The runner has handled every date up to this one.

last_fired_date.description: The latest date a transaction was created for.

items.description:
A saved, partial transaction. The editor fills itself from it; using it
defaults the date to today.

kind.description:
`withdrawal`, `deposit` or `transfer`: which accounts the editor
offers when the template has none.

client.description:
`browser` (default): the session arrives as a cookie. `desktop`: the
session token is returned in the body for `Authorization: Bearer`,
and no cookie is set (the desktop app keeps it in the OS keychain).

MeView.description: The caller, their household and their role (`GET /auth/me`).

opening.description: Net worth at the end of the day before `from`.

owner_user_id.description: The member whose accounts count; `null` for the whole household.

reached_on.description: The day the alert scheduler saw it reached.

start_amount.description: Net worth when the goal was created.

value.description: Net worth at the end of the interval.

NetWorthReport.description:
The sum of the asset and liability balances counted in net worth, at the
end of each interval, per account currency.

NotificationType.description: An event type a channel can subscribe to, as `GET /notification-types` lists it.

split_id.description: The split that paid this period.

account_id.description: Required when more than one account is linked.

split_id.description: A transfer split into or out of the account that moved the money.

PiggyBankPatch.description: Fields left out keep their value; `null` clears a nullable one.

account_ids.description: Replaces the linked accounts; one still holding money cannot go (409).

PiggyBankView.description: A piggy bank. Amounts are decimal strings in its currency.

accounts.description: The linked accounts with the amount saved in each.

left_to_save.description: Target minus saved, never below zero; `None` without a target.

monthly_limit.description:
The monthly budget in the card's currency. Required for a new plan;
on an existing plan it sets the budget from the current month on.

settlement_account_id.description: An active asset account in the card's currency, not the card.

settlement_day.description:
1 to 31: the day of the following month the card is paid (the last
day of a shorter month).

ReconciliationDraftView.description: What reconciling up to a date starts from.

cleared_balance.description: Reconciled splits and opening balances up to the date.

reconciled_through.description: The latest reconciliation's statement date, if any.

splits.description: The splits up to the date the bank has not confirmed yet, oldest first.

difference.description:
What the statement had more than the confirmed splits ("0.00" when
they agreed); booked as the `difference_group_id` transaction.

split_ids.description: The splits it confirmed, the difference's included.

RecurrenceFiredView.description: The result of firing, also the data of the `recurrence.fired` event.

created.description: False when the recurrence had already fired on this date.

apply_rules.description: Whether rules run on the transactions it creates.

fired_through.description: The runner has handled every date up to this one.

last_fired_date.description: The latest date a transaction was created for.

skip.description: `1` = every second date, and so on.

ReportRange.description: What every report echoes back: the span and the interval it was cut into.

Role.description: A member's role in their household.

changed.description: Groups that the rule actually changed.

matched.description: Transaction groups with a matching split.

RuleMatch.description: One split a rule would change.

RuleRequest.description: A whole rule (POST creates, PUT replaces).

strict.description: All triggers must match (`true`) or any one.

matches.description: The first matches (at most 100), newest first.

stop_processing.description: Skip the group's later rules after this one matched.

strict.description: All triggers must match (`true`) or any one.

amount.description: Always positive: the formula gives the sign.

part.description: The part it belongs to, as named in `parts`.

SafeToSpendParts.description:
Every part is zero or more; the formula adds the first two and
subtracts the rest.

bills.description: Bills still due this month (open and overdue), at their highest amount.

budgets.description:
What budgets have left for the rest of the month (prorated by days
for limits running past it).

income_planned.description:
Deposits planned for the rest of the month (recurrences, transactions
dated later).

income_received.description: Deposits from the 1st of the month to today.

piggy_banks.description: What piggy banks with a target date need this month.

planned.description: Other withdrawals planned for the rest of the month.

spent.description: Withdrawals from the 1st of the month to today.

currency.description: The household's primary currency; other currencies are left out.

from.description: The first and last day of the current month (household time).

items.description:
What each part is made of (not `income_received` and `spent`, which
are this month's cash flow).

per_day.description: `safe_to_spend` over the days left, today included, rounded down.

safe_to_spend.description: Income (received and planned) minus everything spent or committed.

filters.description: The page's filters, as the client stored them.

SessionClient.description:
Which app a login session was opened for. Stored in the session's
`name` column (tokens use it for their label); sessions opened before
this existed have none.

SessionView.description: One of the caller's login sessions (not a personal access token).

current.description: True for the session that made this request.

date.description: The payment day of the following month.

group_id.description: The transfer, when there is one.

SetupStatus.description: Whether the first-run setup is still needed.

SplitRequest.description: One split. Money moves from `source_id` to `destination_id`.

currency.description: Defaults to the currency of the asset or liability side.

id.description:
`PUT` only: the existing split this one continues, keeping its ID and
attachments. Leave it out for a new split; the group's splits that
no entry names are deleted with their attachments.

reconciled.description:
Whether the bank confirmed the split. Left out: `false` for a new
split, the stored value for a split named by `id` in a `PUT`.

SplitView.description: One split. Amounts are decimal strings in their currency.

SubscriptionCandidateView.description: A repeating payment that could become a bill.

confidence.description: The share of gaps that fit the frequency, 0 to 100.

SubscriptionDismissalView.description: A suggestion the household does not want to see again.

TagDuplicateGroup.description: Two or more tags with the same name ignoring case, most used first.

TagUsageView.description: A tag with the number of splits that carry it.

TemplateSplitRequest.description: One split of the transaction each firing creates.

piggy_bank_id.description: A transfer into (out of) a linked account adds to (removes from) it.

TemplateSplitView.description: One template split. Amounts are decimal strings in their currency.

event_id.description: The `webhook.test` event that will be delivered to this endpoint only.

error.description: Why the send failed (never contains secrets).

TokenView.description: A personal access token without its secret.

TransactionTemplatePatch.description: Fields left out keep their value; `splits` replaces all splits.

TransactionTemplateSplitRequest.description: One partial split; every field is optional.

currency.description:
Defaults to the currency of the asset or liability side, else the
household's primary currency.

TransactionTemplateSplitView.description:
One partial split; every field may be missing. Amounts are decimal
strings. This is also the JSON stored in `transaction_templates.splits`.

TransactionTemplateView.description:
A saved, partial transaction. The editor fills itself from it; using it
defaults the date to today.

kind.description:
`withdrawal`, `deposit` or `transfer`: which accounts the editor
offers when the template has none.

TriggerView.description: A trigger as stored and as the API shows it.

UploadForm.description: The multipart form (documentation only; the handler reads the parts).

file.description: The file; its part's file name and content type are kept.

public_key.description:
The base64url key for `pushManager.subscribe`; `null` when the server
has no `SALDO_VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY` (Web Push is off).

active.description: `true` re-enables a deactivated endpoint and clears its failure count.

WebhookView.description: An endpoint as the API returns it. Never contains the secret.

consecutive_failures.description: Dead deliveries in a row; 20 deactivate the endpoint.

disabled_reason.description: Why the server deactivated the endpoint, if it did.

include_import_events.description: Also send events written by the Firefly importer.

WebhookWithSecret.description:
An endpoint together with its signing secret: returned once, by create
and rotate-secret.

secret.description: The HMAC key. Store it now: it is never shown again.

YearOverYearReport.description: One amount per month for several years, to compare like with like.

category_id.description: The category it is limited to (`none`: without a category).

change.description: `total` minus the previous year's total over the same months.

month_change_bp.description:
Each month against the same month a year earlier, in basis points;
`null` for months to come, the first year, or nothing a year earlier.

months.description: January to December; `null` for months still to come.

total.description: The sum of the months so far.
